L01_related_source_items.source_assertion_body_verbatim: The 2007 proposal puts Standard Model and gravitational fields into an E8-valued principal-bundle connection/superconnection.
The 2007 model assigns gravity, gauge, frame-Higgs, and fermionic sectors through a noncompact E8 decomposition.
The 2007 proposal assigns triality a generation-related role.
The current source family contains genuine revision/reframing relations and must not be collapsed into a single timeless Lisi model.

L01 places gauge fields, gravitational spin connection, frame, Higgs multiplet, and Grassmann-valued fermions over a four-dimensional base manifold, with different form degree/statistics/representation roles.

L01 combines bosonic Lie-algebra-valued 1-forms and fermionic Lie-algebra-valued Grassmann fields into one BRST-extended/superconnection A with fixed coefficients on the spin-connection and frame-Higgs terms.
L01 defines curvature by F=dA+1/2[A,A] and uses Lie brackets both as algebraic interaction structure and, in selected exceptional embeddings, as the source of subgroup-representation actions.

L01 defines Cartan subalgebra, root vectors, weights, and Cartan-Weyl decomposition; root addition corresponds to nonzero Lie brackets and particle interaction incidence, while weight coordinates are interpreted as particle quantum numbers.

L01 embeds su(3) together with defining 3 and dual bar3 weight carriers into g2=g2 decomposition su(3)+3+bar3, treating quark/anti-quark generators as Lie-algebra root vectors rather than only external representation vectors.
L01 represents gravitational so(3,1)=Cl^2(3,1) using explicit chiral Clifford matrices, decomposes the spin connection into left/right chiral blocks, and represents the frame in Cl^1(3,1).
L01 represents electroweak structure through a second Clifford/D2 sector, combines the frame with a Higgs vector, and joins gravitational/electroweak weights into a graviweak D4/so(7,1) structure.
L01 builds explicit Cl(7,1) generators and the graviweak connection H1=1/2 omega+1/4 e phi+w_ew, acting chirally on an 8-dimensional positive-chiral spinor carrier.
L01 introduces a canonical order-three D4 triality rotation cycling 8_S+, 8_S-, and 8_V and tentatively uses the three triality-related 8-dimensional roles for the three fermion generations.
L01 embeds the graviweak D4 material into F4 and represents graviweak particle interactions by root addition/Lie brackets inside that exceptional algebra.
L01 combines F4 and G2+U(1) quantum-number structures so that 222 gravitational/Standard-Model field weights match 222 of the 240 E8 roots before the remaining roots are assigned to new fields.

The E8 construction introduces an additional quantum number w and new w and xPhi field sectors; F4 is used as the centralizer of G2 in E8 and the chosen Cartan coordinates are related by explicit rotations.

L01 decomposes the E8 connection into two bosonic sectors H1 and H2 plus three fermionic generation sectors Psi_I, Psi_II, Psi_III associated with triality-related 8-dimensional roles and color/lepton factors.
L01 expands the unified curvature into F1, F2, and covariant derivatives of the three fermion sectors, retaining the E8-valued 2-form/Grassmann-form grading.

Within F1, L01 decomposes curvature into gravitational, mixed graviweak, and electroweak parts; the gravitational term combines Riemann curvature with an e e phi^2 term, while the mixed term is torsion times phi minus e Dphi.
Within F2, L01 decomposes curvature into w, B2, x, and strong su(3) parts plus an xPhi xPhi contribution, and defines the mixed x-sector through covariant derivatives of x and Phi.

L01 gives the fermionic curvature as a covariant massive Dirac derivative whose left and right algebra actions include spin, frame-Higgs, electroweak, new-field, and color terms; the other generations are asserted to have analogous curvature pieces.

L01 chooses a modified BF action with E8-valued bosonic and anti-Grassmann Lagrange-multiplier fields; eliminating the bosonic multiplier yields gravitational, fermionic, and non-gravitational gauge/action terms.

The gravitational action is reduced through the MacDowell-Mansouri-style curvature to Palatini/Einstein-Hilbert form plus cosmological constant, with Higgs magnitude acting as a conformal factor for the frame.
The non-gravitational bosonic action contains torsion, Higgs kinetic, electroweak, strong, and new-field pieces; L01 explicitly calls the new-field action a first guess likely to change.
L01 states that the Hodge-star construction requires extracting and inverting the frame part of the E8 connection and calls this procedure awkward and in need of a more natural justification.

L01 derives a one-generation massive Dirac action with standard Higgs coupling plus new w and xPhi fermion couplings; the latter are not well understood, and the actions for the other two triality-related generations are not known well enough to write down.

L01 summarizes the action as chosen by hand to agree with known Standard Model/gravity dynamics, gives high-energy coupling relations and Higgs-VEV relations for cosmological constant/masses, and claims no free parameters at that level.

L01 explicitly states that the generation/triality relation is not perfectly clear and that understanding of the new w+xPhi fields, the chosen noncompact E8 real form, and related phenomenology remains incomplete.
L01 presents possible quantum-gravity/spin-foam/asymptotic-safety/Kac-Moody connections as speculative future directions rather than established components of the proposed classical unification.

L01 states that the proposal should be treated skeptically until poorly understood aspects are resolved and frames future experimental/theoretical work as capable of producing a fatal contradiction rather than assuming correctness.

D4 abstract triality T^3=1 has order three, but the selected E8 extension T is described as somewhat arbitrary and generations as tentative; never conflated with canonically unique physical generation embedding.

seven_additional_source_granularity_obli.issue: Eq3.3 explicitly F^G=1/2(R−1/8 e e phi²); finite coefficients 1/2,1/8 and directional operands must be source retained.

author_modalities.D4_triality_vs_E8_T: T^3=1 abstract D4 triality; selected E8 physical-coordinate T described by author as somewhat arbitrary; generation assignment explicitly tentative and charge/spin only valid under stipulated triality equivalence.
author_modalities.later_generation_actions: Source §3.2.3 states other two generation actions are not understood sufficiently to write down; no generated complete action licensed.
author_modalities.new_xPhi_higgs: Source §2.4.1 describes mass/mixing conjectures as possible and suggests predictions, not confirmed particle phenomenology.
author_modalities.non_gravitational_bosons: Source §3.2.2 calls new-field sector action a first guess, likely to change.
author_modalities.hodge_star: Hodge dual requires extracting/inverting frame from E8 connection; author says lacks natural justification.
author_modalities.gravity_action: Source §3.2.1 Chern-Simons boundary term explicitly removed; equality of derived Palatini action is modulo boundary.
author_modalities.E8_no_parameters: Source §4 asserts coupling ratios and no free parameters at this level; not externally tested empirical evidence.
author_modalities.quantum_speculation: Source §5 quantum gravity/Kac–Moody ideas are prospective, not derived dynamics.
author_modalities.sceptical_conclusion: Source §5 explicitly allows fatal empirical contradiction.
